Author: Kriss-Hietala
Name: Duty Ledger
Description: Logs the duty instances you complete: name, job, start/end time, result (Clear/Wipe), and rewards (gil, tomestones). Includes stats, a filterable table, roulette detection, loot tracking, queue-time tracking, and a weekly chart.
Punchline: Your duty diary - history, stats, loot and queue times in one window.
